title: Rani Pink Embroidered Kurti with Side Tie-Up
description:
Pari means “fairy” – a bright rani pink kurti that brings a little magic.

A bright rani pink kurti in light georgette, knee length with a round neck and elbow sleeves. A breezy straight kurti with delicate white thread embroidery scattered all over. The lined bodice sits above a sheer lower panel, with side tie-up cords and tassels that let you adjust the fit, and a keyhole back with a button closure.

Style it with jeans for college or office, or with palazzos for festive days. Made in Jaipur.
care: Gentle hand wash or dry clean.
